svg.title: How series and shunt parts and line length move a point on the Smith chart
svg.desc: Five small Smith charts. A series inductor moves the point clockwise (up) along its constant-r circle; a series capacitor moves it counter-clockwise (down). A shunt capacitor moves it clockwise along its constant-g circle; a shunt inductor counter-clockwise. A length of matched line rotates it clockwise around the centre at constant |Gamma|.
svg.text: Every part you add moves the point along a known circle
Series part: stays on its r circle.
Shunt part: stays on its g circle.
Series examples start at z = 0.5, shunt examples at z = 2 (g = 0.5). The line example starts at z = 0.5 + j0.5 and shows λ/4 of line (half a turn).
